context: Gale is a companion wizard from Waterdeep who appears as a party member; this is his default, in-world dialogue when you speak to him outside of scripted scenes. He presents himself as a scholarly, well-traveled mage with a cat, a library, a taste for wine and occasional poetry, but he is also very protective of his privacy. The player (or another companion) can attempt to probe his mind, and Gale maintains magical mental defenses that flare and can be forcibly breached briefly — an intrusion that he responds to with anger. His canned responses can also vary to acknowledge recent events or revelations (romantic beats, newly acquired items, confessions like the Dark Urge, or things involving Astarion), but those specifics are handled elsewhere.
